analysis_type: Post-hoc computational validation; not clinical preregistration or IRB approval

synthetic.fixed_witness: oracle of (stored 3-decimal entropy, fixed diagnosis); full-sequence solution never used as a witness for partial disclosure
synthetic.unresolved_metrics: Report both fixed-summary-witness unresolved and audit-unresolved with full completion witness at 100% enumeration

partition_details.homogeneous_duplicates: Within each prediction class and correctness group, random chunks of 2..8 (last chunk may be singleton); first pure-correct block per prediction class uses unanimous labels.
partition_details.unanimous_mixed: Per class, round(60% correct) and round(60% errors) allocated to one unanimous block; remaining rows grouped separately by correctness.
partition_details.distributed_mixed: Per class, round(20% correct) and round(20% errors) allocated to one unanimous block; all remaining rows partitioned into mixed non-unanimous blocks where feasible, each seeded with at least one correct and one error.
partition_details.mostly_unique: Per class, round(10% correct) and round(10% errors) each allocated to one unanimous and one non-unanimous block; remaining rows have unique non-unanimous sequences.
partition_details.sequence_generation: Unique sequence per designed block; modal label appears 11..19 of 20 positions for non-unanimous blocks; residual counts and order randomized; all modes unique. Symbolic categories K0,K1,K2.
partition_details.paired_design: Same n, exact total errors, predictions and row-level correctness across the four scenarios for each n/seed; scenarios differ in partition/sequence structure. No real patient labels altered.

synthetic_signal_control.observation: 12 fixed sequence templates independent of errors; modal diagnosis in {K0,K1,K2}; signal equals the error bit with specified probability, in a declared synthetic joint distribution only; iid bit and unique IDs independent of errors.
synthetic_signal_control.learner: Laplace-smoothed empirical error frequency by policy key, trained on training set only; unseen keys fall back to training modal risk. Unique IDs disjoint across train/cal/test.
synthetic_signal_control.threshold: On separate calibration set maximize nonempty coverage subject to empirical risk<=0.05; tied scores accepted together. If none qualifies accept nothing. No test-label threshold adjustment.
synthetic_signal_control.report: Training empirical oracle plus fixed learned gate test risk/coverage. Empty-selection risk is NA. This is an artificial positive/negative control, not clinical generalization.

validation.scipy_check: All 32 clinical evidence subsets x21 alphas, plus first synthetic seed at each size/scenario x11 evidence settings x3 alphas, plus 100 random block tests x3 alphas

changes_from_proposal: Specified the previously unspecified synthetic partition mechanisms, random streams, noise cardinalities and positive-signal independent train/cal/test mechanism before running these studies.
Unrounded entropy equivalence uses the exact integer product of nonzero count**count (fixed T=20), not fragile floating-point equality.
Unresolved with a fixed summary witness is recorded separately from full-enumeration audit resolution; the full oracle never leaks into partial-stage feasibility witnesses.
No public external dataset, clinical Confidence/Features gate, new LLM query, reader assessment, or clinical independent test is included.
